title: Unary prefix of a pair encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean word, and let $y$ be the pair encoding of the word of $n$ ones and $w$. For every natural number $k<2n$, the symbol of $y$ at zero-based position $k$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ equals the pair encoding of $n$ ones and $w$
